continuity_scope: DARK SOULS REMASTERED, English-language Bandai Namco product-page boundary: the remastered release of 2011's Dark Souls, with Artorias of the Abyss included. This pass uses the official English product/release/patch witnesses and does not conflate original, Prepare to Die, regional editions, later Remastered patches, Dark Souls II/III, trilogy packages, adaptations, or external interpretations.
work_or_witnesses: Bandai Namco Entertainment: DARK SOULS: REMASTERED official product page
FromSoftware/Bandai Namco: DARK SOULS REMASTERED coming to multiple current-generation platforms
Bandai Namco Europe: Rekindle your humanity with DARK SOULS: REMASTERED
Bandai Namco Europe: Dark Souls: Remastered patch note 1.03
coverage_rule: Zero-character evidence-constrained pass. The selected official product, release, and patch witnesses establish edition/package, Lordran, Curse, player-authored playstyle, online covenants, multiplayer, and a player-avatar address ('Chosen Undead'), but do not provide reproducible, claim-level named NPC/boss profiles or direct in-game dialogue/item-description locators. The Chosen Undead is an excluded player role, not a stable named node. No fan source is used to manufacture a cast.
omissions: The Chosen Undead/player avatar, all selected class/build, covenant, multiplayer role, choices, actions, endings, and New Game cycles.

All named NPCs, bosses, deities, invaders, summons, merchants, and other dramatic individuals because the selected first-party witnesses lack individual claim-level profiles or direct dialogue/item-description locators.
Covenants, classes, species, bosses as categories, items, weapons, armor, spells, crafting, places, cycles, multiplayer systems, and patch bugs as character nodes.

Original and Prepare to Die release states as separate detailed witnesses; regional/localized versions; later patches; Dark Souls II, Dark Souls III, trilogy package material; adaptations; fan/community/wiki sources, walkthroughs, item-description transcriptions, data-mines, and secondary character databases.
uncertainties: The official current product pages are high-level promotional/edition witnesses. Direct in-game dialogue and item descriptions—the primary basis needed for detailed character claims—were not accessible in the reviewed first-party sources. This audit remains terms-only rather than substituting fan transcriptions.

Dark Souls uses intentionally sparse and potentially interpretive in-world text in its item descriptions and dialogue, but no such direct text is cited here. No lore inference, contested chronology, motivation, identity, or relationship is asserted.
The product page uses English marketing terminology; original Japanese text and other localization phrasing were not collated, so no translation-equivalence claim is made.

Remastered includes Artorias of the Abyss, has enhanced online functions, and has patch-specific behavior. This pass records the package/boundary only and does not infer uniform online service, balance, or story experience across time/platforms.

The official product pitch says playthroughs reveal new facets and online interactions can involve collaboration, confrontation, support, or betrayal. These are player-dependent systems, not universal narrative events or relationships.
evidence_basis: First-party Bandai Namco and FromSoftware product, press-release, and patch-note pages only. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, community guide, item-transcription database, lore video, walkthrough, mod, or secondary source is used as canonical evidence.
